sourceTitle: The Pleasures of England Lectures given in Oxford
description: "The Pleasures of England" by John Ruskin is a collection of lectures delivered at Oxford, likely written in the late 19th century. The work addresses the intersections of art, faith, and national character, exploring the development of English culture through various epochs and promoting a greater appreciation for its heritage.
